name: Fashion and Appearance
blurb: Trang phục, xu hướng, ngoại hình

words.meaningVi: phong cách, tiêu chuẩn về vẻ đẹp
words.definitionEn: a set of principles concerned with the appreciation and criticism of beauty
words.example: The designer's aesthetic emphasizes minimalism and sustainable materials.

words.meaningVi: cửa hàng thời trang cao cấp, nhỏ
words.definitionEn: a small shop selling fashionable or specialized items
words.example: She discovered a luxury boutique in the city center that specializes in vintage clothing.

words.meaningVi: lựa chọn cẩn thận, sắp xếp
words.definitionEn: to select and organize items or content carefully
words.example: Influencers curate their wardrobes to reflect current fashion trends.

words.definitionEn: the outline or shape of something, especially a garment
words.example: The evening gown featured an elegant silhouette that flattered her figure.

words.definitionEn: able to be used in many different ways or for many purposes
words.example: A versatile blazer can be worn casually or formally depending on styling.

words.meaningVi: bảng màu, tổng hợp màu sắc
words.definitionEn: a range of colors or qualities
words.example: The season's color palette features earth tones and pastels.

words.meaningVi: may đo, vừa vặn, phù hợp
words.definitionEn: made or adapted for a particular person or purpose; fitted closely to the body
words.example: Tailored suits convey professionalism in corporate environments.

words.definitionEn: an item of clothing
words.example: The quality of each garment reflects the designer's meticulous attention to detail.

words.definitionEn: to make more attractive by adding decorative details
words.example: Embellished dresses with beads and sequins are popular for evening events.

words.definitionEn: material made by weaving or knitting fibers
words.example: Sustainable fabrics like organic cotton are increasingly used in ethical fashion.

words.definitionEn: a general direction or tendency, especially in fashion
words.example: Fast fashion trends often prioritize affordability over sustainability.

words.definitionEn: the relationship in size, amount, or degree between things
words.example: Proper proportion in clothing design ensures a balanced and flattering look.

words.definitionEn: a small item worn or carried to complement an outfit
words.example: Accessories such as belts and scarves can transform a basic outfit.

words.definitionEn: refined and elegant in appearance or manner
words.example: The sophisticated styling demonstrated her understanding of high fashion principles.

words.definitionEn: modern; belonging to the present time
words.example: Contemporary fashion designers often challenge traditional notions of beauty.

words.meaningVi: kết cấu, cảm giác bề mặt
words.definitionEn: the feel, appearance, or consistency of a surface or fabric
words.example: Mixing different textures creates visual interest and depth in an outfit.

words.definitionEn: to arrange cloth loosely over something, creating flowing folds
words.example: The fabric drapes elegantly, creating a flattering silhouette.

words.definitionEn: using the fewest and simplest elements to create maximum effect
words.example: Minimalist fashion advocates for fewer, high-quality pieces rather than excessive consumption.

words.meaningVi: sự thỏa mãn, sự xa xỉ
words.definitionEn: the act of satisfying a desire or enjoying something pleasurable
words.example: Luxury fashion brands market themselves as an indulgence for discerning consumers.

words.definitionEn: to comply with standards, rules, or expectations
words.example: Not all individuals choose to conform to mainstream fashion norms.
words.collocation: conform to standards, conform to expectations

words.definitionEn: featuring new methods or ideas; advanced and original
words.example: Innovative designers experiment with unconventional materials to create sustainable fashion.

words.meaningVi: cầu kỳ, trang trí công phu
words.definitionEn: elaborately and heavily decorated
words.example: Ornate evening wear with intricate details remains popular for formal occasions.

words.definitionEn: to make more polished, elegant, or precise
words.example: Refining one's personal style involves understanding body proportions and color theory.

words.definitionEn: to display a quality openly and obviously
words.example: Her carefully chosen outfit exuded confidence and professional competence.

words.meaningVi: phổ biến, có mặt khắp nơi
words.definitionEn: present, appearing, or found everywhere
words.example: Fast fashion brands have become ubiquitous in shopping malls worldwide.

words.definitionEn: clothes, especially of a formal or ceremonial type
words.example: The guests were expected to wear formal attire for the gala dinner.

words.definitionEn: a coordinated outfit or set of clothes worn together
words.example: She wore a stunning ensemble consisting of a tailored jacket and matching trousers.

words.definitionEn: the design and manufacture of fashionable custom-made clothes
words.example: Many celebrities choose couture for red-carpet events to ensure a unique look.

words.meaningVi: tủ quần áo (toàn bộ quần áo)
words.definitionEn: a person's entire collection of clothes
words.example: A minimalist wardrobe often consists of neutral colors and timeless pieces.

words.definitionEn: clothing, especially when sold in shops
words.example: The retail sector has seen a surge in sustainable apparel made from recycled materials.

words.definitionEn: made to order according to the customer's specifications
words.example: He prefers bespoke suits because they fit perfectly and reflect his personal style.

words.definitionEn: elegantly and stylishly fashionable
words.example: The designer's collection was praised for its chic simplicity and clean lines.

words.definitionEn: graceful and stylish in appearance or manner
words.example: An elegant evening gown can make a powerful impression at formal events.

words.definitionEn: following current trends in clothing or appearance
words.example: Young people often try to wear fashionable items to express their identity.

words.definitionEn: tending to attract attention because of brightly colored or showy clothes
words.example: His flamboyant style often includes bold patterns and vibrant colors.

words.meaningVi: tinh tươm, hoàn hảo (về trang phục)
words.definitionEn: perfectly clean, neat, or tidy
words.example: The bride's dress was immaculate, with no wrinkles or stains visible.

words.meaningVi: hoàn hảo, không chê vào đâu được
words.definitionEn: in accordance with the highest standards of propriety; faultless
words.example: Her taste in fashion is impeccable, always choosing pieces that suit her perfectly.

words.definitionEn: sumptuously rich, elaborate, or luxurious
words.example: The celebrity wore a lavish gown adorned with diamonds and sequins.

words.meaningVi: kín đáo, giản dị (về trang phục)
words.definitionEn: not showing one's body or wearing anything too revealing or extravagant
words.example: Some cultures require modest clothing that covers the shoulders and knees.

words.meaningVi: kỳ quặc, gây sốc (về thời trang)
words.definitionEn: very unusual and intended to shock or draw attention
words.example: The designer's outrageous creations often provoke debate in the fashion industry.

words.definitionEn: in its original condition; unspoiled
words.example: The vintage dress was in pristine condition despite being decades old.

words.definitionEn: imitating styles from the recent past, especially the 1950s to 1970s
words.example: Retro fashion has made a comeback, with many people wearing flared trousers again.

words.definitionEn: neat, trim, and stylish in appearance
words.example: A smart casual dress code is often required for business meetings.

words.definitionEn: having a fashionable appearance
words.example: She always looks stylish even in simple clothes because of her confident attitude.

words.definitionEn: a person who starts new fashions or ideas
words.example: Fashion influencers act as trendsetters, shaping what people wear worldwide.

words.definitionEn: the prevailing fashion or style at a particular time
words.example: Sustainable fashion is currently in vogue among environmentally conscious consumers.

words.meaningVi: món đồ cơ bản không thể thiếu
words.definitionEn: a basic, essential item of clothing that is always useful
words.example: A white shirt is considered a wardrobe staple because it can be dressed up or down.

words.definitionEn: a set of rules specifying the required style of clothing
words.example: The company has a strict dress code that prohibits jeans and sneakers.

words.definitionEn: the design and production of exclusive, custom-fitted high-end fashion
words.example: Haute couture houses create one-of-a-kind garments for wealthy clients.

words.definitionEn: ahead of current trends; adopting styles before they become mainstream
words.example: Fashion-forward individuals often experiment with avant-garde designs.
